externalSources.title: 新能源汽车迎来两个“首次”突破
externalSources.excerptPreview: 2026年7月,新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首次突破60%、累计占比首次突破50%——中国汽车工业协会最新发布的一组数据备受关注。 理解这两个“首次”的分量,首先要看清统计口径。此前“占比过半”等说法多针对乘用车品类或国内销售市场,而此次数据则囊括了乘用车和商用车、国内销量和汽车出口,是真正意义上跨过了“半壁江山”的分水岭,标志着新能源汽车已经成为市场主流。 看国内车市,今年以来新能源乘用车国内销量占比逐月提升,7月已达到68.1%,相当于每卖出3辆新车,就有2辆是新能源汽车。商用车的电动化转型速度也保持较快增长,7月新能源商用车国内销量同比增速近五成。 看汽车出海,新能源汽车出口占比连续两个月

externalSources.title: 汽车首季报出炉!迎来开门红
externalSources.excerptPreview: 中国汽车工业协会4月11日发布数据显示,2025年一季度,我国汽车产销累计完成756.1万辆和747万辆,同比分别增长14.5%和11.2%,其中新能源汽车产销分别增长50.4%和47.1%。 我国目前是全球最大汽车生产国和出口国。面对美国加征关税等复杂外部环境,我国汽车产销延续旺势,从一个侧面印证大国经济的韧性与活力。 政策赋能,汽车产销总体两旺 651.3万辆和641.9万辆,这是一季度我国乘用车的累计产销量,16.1%和12.9%的增幅离不开政策工具箱的持续发力。 今年以来,消费品以旧换新政策加力扩围,多地配套消费券等激励措施,加上新能源车购置税减免政策延续实施,“换新车”成为更多消费者

externalSources.title: 3100万辆,这份答卷含金量十足
externalSources.excerptPreview: 3100万辆,这份答卷含金量十足 汽车产销分别完成3128.2万辆和3143.6万辆。 新能源汽车产销分别完成1288.8万辆和1286.6万辆。 汽车出口585.9万辆。 2024年,中国汽车产业再上新台阶。1月13日,中国汽车工业协会发布最新数据,得益于“两新”政策持续发力、汽车产业加快转型,2024年,我国汽车产销双超3100万辆。其中新能源汽车产销均超1280万辆,连续10年位居世界首位。 销量站上新台阶 能在年销售3000万辆的高位平台上,实现4.5%的销量增长,最终站稳3100万辆的新台阶,2024年汽车产业交出的这份亮眼答卷,含金量十足。 ——汽车产销总量连续16年稳居全球第一。

externalSources.title: 2025年12月汽车工业经济运行情况

externalSources.title: 新能源乘用车渗透率超50%传递什么信号
externalSources.excerptPreview: 近日,乘用车市场信息联席会发布数据,7月,国内新能源乘用车市场零售销量为87.8万辆,同比增长36.9%,渗透率达到51.1%,较去年同期提升15个百分点,单月零售渗透率首次超过50%。在不少业内人士看来,新能源车的零售销量首次完成对传统燃油车的超越,标志着汽车行业将进入新的发展阶段。 乘联会秘书长崔东树介绍,新能源汽车渗透率是指新能源车在整体乘用车销量中的占比。渗透率的提升意味着新能源车得到了更多消费者的认可。 崔东树分析,新能源乘用车月销渗透率首破50%大关,主要得益于我国日趋完善的汽车制造体系,特别是自主车企创新性地发展插混技术,实现狭义插混和增程式的技术突破,中国插混占世界插混市场份额

externalSources.title: 前三季度动力电池装车量同比增长16.7%
externalSources.excerptPreview: 10月15日,中国汽车动力电池产业创新联盟发布数据。今年9月,国内动力电池装车量为87.2GWh(吉瓦时),环比增长10.4%,同比增长14.7%。前三季度,随着新能源商用车及新能源汽车单车带电量的增长,我国动力电池累计装车量达到576.3GWh,同比增长16.7%,纯电动货车和纯电动专用车对装车量的带动作用明显。 该联盟发布的数据还显示,前三季度,我国动力和储能电池的产量、销量均已超过2025年全年产销总量,继续保持稳定增长。此外,前三季度,我国动力和储能电池累计出口302.9GWh,同比增长51.6%,其中,受整车出口增长、车企的海外工厂陆续投产等因素影响,动力电池出口增速高于储能电池。

externalSources.title: 机床液压系统80%的故障源于这三点,看完少走三年弯路
externalSources.excerptPreview: 机床液压系统是数控机床实现工件夹紧、刀架转位、工作台进给、主轴变速等核心动作的关键动力源,直接决定了机床的加工精度、运行稳定性和生产效率。但很多工厂的设备故障频发,其实80%的问题都源于污染、过热和进气这三大因素。本文从系统组成、工作原理、关键设计要点、常见故障排查到维护保养,系统梳理机床液压系统的核心知识,帮你避开那些踩了三年才总结出来的坑。 机床液压系统主要由以下部分组成:中小型机床常用4kW电机驱动叶片泵(流量30-60L/min),高精度机床采用柱塞泵(压力10-16MPa)。 ·执行元件:液压缸(实现直线运动,如卡盘夹紧、尾座伸缩、工作台进给)和液压马达(实现旋转运动,如刀架转位)。

externalSources.title: 融合故障树与机器学习的数控机床故障诊断专家系统实践
externalSources.excerptPreview: 1. 先把问题想透:传统诊断方式差在哪 1.1 报警代码只是起点,不是终点 数控系统的报警体系设计得非常严密,几乎所有异常都会触发PLC报警代码,主轴过载、伺服超差、液压压力低、刀具寿命到限、冷却液不足等等。但一个容易被忽视的事实是:报警是系统根据预设条件触发的,它告诉你“哪个参数越界了”,却不告诉你“为什么越界”。 拿前面提到的“主轴驱动过热”来说,可能的原因包括环境温度过高、冷却系统失效、切削负载过大、主轴轴承磨损、电机绕组老化、甚至参数配置错误。同一个报警代码背后可能对应二三十种根因,维修人员如果只按报警代码去换零件,很容易陷入“修完又坏、坏完再修”的循环。

externalSources.title: 造成数控车床液压传动系统产生爬行现象的原因有哪些?如何排除故障?
externalSources.excerptPreview: 造成数控车床液压传动系统产生爬行现象的原因有哪些?如何排除故障? 原因及排除方法如下:1. 液压油中混有空气:因空气压缩性大,含气泡的液体在高压区受压缩使油液体积变小,导致工作部件爬行。排除方法:在高处部件设置排气装置排除空气。2. 相对运动部件间摩擦阻力太大或变化:活塞、活塞杆等零件形位公差及表面粗糙度不符合要求,或系统、油液不清洁导致污物进入增大摩擦。排除方法:检查零件形位公差和表面粗糙度,保证系统及油液清洁。3. 密封件密封不良导致泄漏:密封件损坏或连接处不可靠使液压油泄漏。排除方法:更换密封件,检查连接处可靠性,旧设备可加大液压泵流量抑制爬行。

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT q.inspection_id, q.order_id, q.inspection_time, q.inspection_stage, o.product_id, p.product_name, o.machine_id, o.line_id, o.shift, q.sample_size, q.defect_count, ROUND(q.defect_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(q.sample_size, 0), 4) AS sample_defect_rate, q.defect_type, q.measured_value_mm, q.spec_lower_mm, q.spec_upper_mm, q.result, q.inspector_id, (CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN q.defect_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(q.sample_size, 0) > ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity_score, TRIM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN q.defect_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(q.sample_size, 0) > ? THEN '?' ELSE '?' END, '?' ) AS exception_reasons FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE o.machine_id IN (?) AND ((q.result = '?' ) OR (q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm) OR (q.defect_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(q.sample_size, 0) > ?)) ORDER BY severity_score DESC, sample_defect_rate DESC, q.inspection_time DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

kwh_per_good_unit aligns energy and production by the selected machine/date scope, not by a direct meter-to-order link.

externalSources.excerptPreview: ISO 50001标准是能源管理的较佳实践 能源管理体系是在全球经济向低碳经济转型的大背景下产生的,而ISO 50001能源管理体系标准是目前国际上关于能源管理方面的较佳实践。该标准可以帮助各种规模的企业了解各个工作流程的基准能源使用量,制定与重要能源消费相关的目标、指标以及行动方案,以应对来自节能减排以及因能源消耗导致的环境影响方面的挑战。 多数工业能效的实现是通过有效的管理能源而不是采用新的技术。

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT MIN(date_from) AS date_from, MAX(date_to) AS date_to FROM (SELECT MIN(substr(o.actual_start,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(o.actual_start,1,10)) AS date_to FROM production_orders o JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE o.actual_start IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(q.inspection_time,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(q.inspection_time,1,10)) AS date_to FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE q.inspection_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(d.start_time,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(d.start_time,1,10)) AS date_to FROM downtime_events d JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = d.machine_id WHERE d.start_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(e.reading_date,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(e.reading_date,1,10)) AS date_to FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id WHERE e.reading_date IS NOT NULL)) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.planned_qty) AS planned_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) - SUM(o.planned_qty) AS plan_variance_qty, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_qty), 0), 4) AS plan_completion_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.good_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS yield_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.scrap_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS scrap_rate, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_cycle_time_min, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_standard_cycle_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min), 0), 4) AS cycle_time_index, ROUND(AVG((julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0), 2) AS avg_start_delay_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY actual_qty DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS pass_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS fail_rate, SUM(q.sample_size) AS sample_size, SUM(q.defect_count) AS defect_count, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 4) AS sample_defect_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 2) AS defects_per_1000_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defect_free_inspection_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS defect_free_inspection_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_spec_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS out_of_spec_rate FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY inspection_count DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT * FROM (SELECT m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.install_date, m.rated_power_kw, m.status FROM machines m ORDER BY m.machine_id) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) AS ideal_runtime_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT d.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS downtime_event_count, SUM(d.duration_min) AS downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.planned_flag = 1 THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS planned_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.planned_flag = 0 THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS unplanned_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.category = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN d.category = '?' THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS failure_downtime_min FROM downtime_events d JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = d.machine_id LEFT JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = NULLIF(d.order_id, '?' ) GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS energy_reading_count, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL)) AS energy_runtime_hours, SUM(e.electricity_kwh) AS electricity_kwh FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.line_id AS line_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, m.manufacturer AS manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw AS rated_power_kw, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty FROM production_orders o JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.machine_id AS machine_id, m.line_id AS line_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, m.manufacturer AS manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw AS rated_power_kw, COUNT(*) AS reading_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.reading_date) AS reading_day_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.machine_id) AS machine_count, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL)) AS runtime_hours, SUM(e.electricity_kwh) AS electricity_kwh, SUM(e.compressed_air_m3) AS compressed_air_m3, SUM(e.coolant_liter) AS coolant_liter, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) * m.rated_power_kw) AS rated_capacity_kwh, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS idle_reading_count, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) = 0 THEN e.electricity_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS idle_electricity_kwh, MAX(e.peak_demand_kw) AS max_peak_demand_kw, AVG(e.peak_demand_kw) AS avg_peak_demand_kw FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT * FROM (SELECT MAX(substr(actual_start,1,10)) AS latest_date FROM production_orders) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

externalSources.title: 振动信号:工业设备自带的健康报警器
externalSources.excerptPreview: 在各类工业环境中,机器一直在跟我们“说话”。它们不是用语言与我们沟通交流,而是通过运动、热量、噪声、压力,尤其是振动等物理现象,清晰地传递自身等健康信息。长期以来,在大多数情况下,只有行业专家才能理解这种语言;如今,随着传感器技术和边缘人工智能的进步,解读这一语言的门槛正在降低,有更多的技工能够听懂机器在说什么,整个行业正迎来一场深刻变革。 其核心原理非常简单却具说服力:机器振动如果测量得足够精确,就能在故障发生前,提前揭示设备内部正在发生的问题。轴承开始磨损、变速箱对中不良、零部件松动等故障部件往往最先通过振动的变化预示健康异常情况。这些异常变化起初可能微乎其微,若置之不理,时间久了会愈发明

THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN o.scrap_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.actual_qty, 0) > ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0 > ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN o.cycle_time_min > p.standard_cycle_min * (1.0 + ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity_score, TRIM( CASE WHEN o.actual_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.planned_qty, 0) < ? THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN o.scrap_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.actual_qty, 0) > ? THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN (julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0 > ? THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN o.cycle_time_min > p.standard_cycle_min * (1.0 + ?) THEN '?' ELSE '?' END, '?' ) AS exception_reasons FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE (o.actual_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.planned_qty, 0) < ? OR o.scrap_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.actual_qty, 0) > ? OR (julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0 > ? OR o.cycle_time_min > p.standard_cycle_min * (1.0 + ?)) ORDER BY severity_score DESC, scrap_rate DESC, start_delay_min DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

externalSources.title: 新能源汽车迎来两个“首次”突破
externalSources.excerptPreview: 2026年7月,新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首次突破60%、累计占比首次突破50%——中国汽车工业协会最新发布的一组数据备受关注。 理解这两个“首次”的分量,首先要看清统计口径。此前“占比过半”等说法多针对乘用车品类或国内销售市场,而此次数据则囊括了乘用车和商用车、国内销量和汽车出口,是真正意义上跨过了“半壁江山”的分水岭,标志着新能源汽车已经成为市场主流。 看国内车市,今年以来新能源乘用车国内销量占比逐月提升,7月已达到68.1%,相当于每卖出3辆新车,就有2辆是新能源汽车。商用车的电动化转型速度也保持较快增长,7月新能源商用车国内销量同比增速近五成。 看汽车出海,新能源汽车出口占比连续两个月

externalSources.title: 汽车首季报出炉!迎来开门红
externalSources.excerptPreview: 中国汽车工业协会4月11日发布数据显示,2025年一季度,我国汽车产销累计完成756.1万辆和747万辆,同比分别增长14.5%和11.2%,其中新能源汽车产销分别增长50.4%和47.1%。 我国目前是全球最大汽车生产国和出口国。面对美国加征关税等复杂外部环境,我国汽车产销延续旺势,从一个侧面印证大国经济的韧性与活力。 政策赋能,汽车产销总体两旺 651.3万辆和641.9万辆,这是一季度我国乘用车的累计产销量,16.1%和12.9%的增幅离不开政策工具箱的持续发力。 今年以来,消费品以旧换新政策加力扩围,多地配套消费券等激励措施,加上新能源车购置税减免政策延续实施,“换新车”成为更多消费者

externalSources.title: 3100万辆,这份答卷含金量十足

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.planned_qty) AS planned_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) - SUM(o.planned_qty) AS plan_variance_qty, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_qty), 0), 4) AS plan_completion_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.good_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS yield_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.scrap_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS scrap_rate, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_cycle_time_min, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_standard_cycle_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min), 0), 4) AS cycle_time_index, ROUND(AVG((julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0), 2) AS avg_start_delay_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY actual_qty DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS pass_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS fail_rate, SUM(q.sample_size) AS sample_size, SUM(q.defect_count) AS defect_count, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 4) AS sample_defect_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 2) AS defects_per_1000_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defect_free_inspection_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS defect_free_inspection_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_spec_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS out_of_spec_rate FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY inspection_count DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) AS ideal_runtime_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

OFFSET ?

OFFSET ?

Cross-domain risk flags are threshold-based screening signals, not causal conclusions.

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.reading_id, e.reading_date, e.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.rated_power_kw, CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) AS runtime_hours, e.electricity_kwh, e.compressed_air_m3, e.coolant_liter, e.peak_demand_kw FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id WHERE ((CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) = 0 AND e.electricity_kwh > ?) OR (CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > 0 AND e.electricity_kwh / CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > ?) OR (CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > 0 AND e.compressed_air_m3 / CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > ?) OR (CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > 0 AND e.coolant_liter / CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > ?) OR (m.rated_power_kw > 0 AND e.peak_demand_kw / m.rated_power_kw > ?)) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN (CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) = 0 AND e.electricity_kwh > ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > 0 AND e.electricity_kwh / CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > 0 AND e.compressed_air_m3 / CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > 0 AND e.coolant_liter / CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) > ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (m.rated_power_kw > 0 AND e.peak_demand_kw / m.rated_power_kw > ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, e.reading_date DESC, e.machine_id) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.planned_qty) AS planned_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) - SUM(o.planned_qty) AS plan_variance_qty, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_qty), 0), 4) AS plan_completion_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.good_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS yield_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.scrap_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS scrap_rate, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_cycle_time_min, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_standard_cycle_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min), 0), 4) AS cycle_time_index, ROUND(AVG((julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0), 2) AS avg_start_delay_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY actual_qty DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS pass_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS fail_rate, SUM(q.sample_size) AS sample_size, SUM(q.defect_count) AS defect_count, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 4) AS sample_defect_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 2) AS defects_per_1000_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defect_free_inspection_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS defect_free_inspection_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_spec_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS out_of_spec_rate FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY inspection_count DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) AS ideal_runtime_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT d.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS downtime_event_count, SUM(d.duration_min) AS downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.planned_flag = 1 THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS planned_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.planned_flag = 0 THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS unplanned_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.category = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN d.category = '?' THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS failure_downtime_min FROM downtime_events d JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = d.machine_id LEFT JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = NULLIF(d.order_id, '?' ) GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS energy_reading_count, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL)) AS energy_runtime_hours, SUM(e.electricity_kwh) AS electricity_kwh FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.line_id AS line_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, m.manufacturer AS manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw AS rated_power_kw, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty FROM production_orders o JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.machine_id AS machine_id, m.line_id AS line_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, m.manufacturer AS manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw AS rated_power_kw, COUNT(*) AS reading_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.reading_date) AS reading_day_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.machine_id) AS machine_count, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL)) AS runtime_hours, SUM(e.electricity_kwh) AS electricity_kwh, SUM(e.compressed_air_m3) AS compressed_air_m3, SUM(e.coolant_liter) AS coolant_liter, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) * m.rated_power_kw) AS rated_capacity_kwh, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS idle_reading_count, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) = 0 THEN e.electricity_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS idle_electricity_kwh, MAX(e.peak_demand_kw) AS max_peak_demand_kw, AVG(e.peak_demand_kw) AS avg_peak_demand_kw FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

Supplier and inventory domains remain plant-wide when machineIds or lineIds filters are used because those domains have no machine/line key.
Cross-domain risk flags are threshold-based screening signals, not causal conclusions.

externalSources.excerptPreview: 数控机床常见故障诊断及维修策略分析 数控机床机床结构故障诊断维修策略随着我国工业实力的不断增强,数控机床的应用范围也在不断扩大,对企业的发展起到了重要的促进作用.然而,由于数控机床所使用的相关零部件具有高精度和复杂的结构,在实际使用中,如果出现故障,将会导致机床停机和无法正常生产,从而造成巨大的经济损失.因此,积极开展数控机床设备的故障诊断与维修工作,成为确保机床正常运转的重要手段.本文在分析了数控机床结构特点与维修现状的基础上,阐述了数控机床常见故障类型,并提出了相应的故障诊断和维修策略,旨在提高机床的可靠性,确保设备正常运行.

externalSources.excerptPreview: 数控机床故障诊断与排除 《数控机床故障诊断与排除》由陈玉阁、李淑艳编著,机械工业出版社2009年出版,是中国高等职业技术教育数控技术专业教学改革教材。该书基于项目化教学理念编写,旨在培养数控机床维修技能,适应高职院校教学模式改革需求。 全书分为数控车床与加工中心两大模块,系统梳理14类典型故障案例。内容涵盖操作面板异常、主轴故障、刀架转位异常等常见问题,通过基础维护到复杂排障的递进训练,结合诊断设备使用技术,阐释故障类型、日常维护规范及诊断定位方法。教材注重理论与实践结合,通过案例教学缩短设备停机时间,延长机床使用寿命,适用于数控技术专业教学及维修人员参考。 中文名:数控机床故障诊断与排除 作

OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.planned_qty) AS planned_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) - SUM(o.planned_qty) AS plan_variance_qty, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_qty), 0), 4) AS plan_completion_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.good_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS yield_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.scrap_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS scrap_rate, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_cycle_time_min, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_standard_cycle_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min), 0), 4) AS cycle_time_index, ROUND(AVG((julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0), 2) AS avg_start_delay_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY actual_qty DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' dataQualityNotes: Production, quality, and order-linked downtime share transactional keys; daily energy is aligned by machine/date rather than directly linked to an order.
Inventory balances are inferred from cumulative movements; finished goods have no sales-shipment demand basis.
Supplier and inventory domains remain plant-wide when machineIds or lineIds filters are used because those domains have no machine/line key.
Cross-domain risk flags are threshold-based screening signals, not causal conclusions.
assumptions: Inventory balances are inferred from cumulative movements; finished goods have no sales-shipment demand basis.

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT MIN(date_from) AS date_from, MAX(date_to) AS date_to FROM (SELECT MIN(substr(o.actual_start,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(o.actual_start,1,10)) AS date_to FROM production_orders o JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE o.actual_start IS NOT NULL AND o.machine_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(q.inspection_time,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(q.inspection_time,1,10)) AS date_to FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE q.inspection_time IS NOT NULL AND o.machine_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(d.start_time,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(d.start_time,1,10)) AS date_to FROM downtime_events d JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = d.machine_id WHERE d.start_time IS NOT NULL AND d.machine_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(e.reading_date,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(e.reading_date,1,10)) AS date_to FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id WHERE e.reading_date IS NOT NULL AND e.machine_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.planned_qty) AS planned_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) - SUM(o.planned_qty) AS plan_variance_qty, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_qty), 0), 4) AS plan_completion_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.good_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS yield_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.scrap_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS scrap_rate, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_cycle_time_min, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_standard_cycle_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min), 0), 4) AS cycle_time_index, ROUND(AVG((julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0), 2) AS avg_start_delay_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE o.machine_id IN (?) GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY actual_qty DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS pass_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS fail_rate, SUM(q.sample_size) AS sample_size, SUM(q.defect_count) AS defect_count, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 4) AS sample_defect_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 2) AS defects_per_1000_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defect_free_inspection_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS defect_free_inspection_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_spec_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS out_of_spec_rate FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE o.machine_id IN (?) GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY inspection_count DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.install_date, m.rated_power_kw, m.status FROM machines m WHERE m.machine_id IN (?) ORDER BY m.machine_id) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) AS ideal_runtime_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE m.machine_id IN (?) GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT d.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS downtime_event_count, SUM(d.duration_min) AS downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.planned_flag = 1 THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS planned_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.planned_flag = 0 THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS unplanned_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.category = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count, SUM(CASE WHEN d.category = '?' THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS failure_downtime_min FROM downtime_events d JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = d.machine_id LEFT JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = NULLIF(d.order_id, '?' ) WHERE m.machine_id IN (?) GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS energy_reading_count, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL)) AS energy_runtime_hours, SUM(e.electricity_kwh) AS electricity_kwh FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id WHERE m.machine_id IN (?) GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.line_id AS line_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, m.manufacturer AS manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw AS rated_power_kw, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty FROM production_orders o JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE m.machine_id IN (?) GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.machine_id AS machine_id, m.line_id AS line_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, m.manufacturer AS manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw AS rated_power_kw, COUNT(*) AS reading_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.reading_date) AS reading_day_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.machine_id) AS machine_count, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL)) AS runtime_hours, SUM(e.electricity_kwh) AS electricity_kwh, SUM(e.compressed_air_m3) AS compressed_air_m3, SUM(e.coolant_liter) AS coolant_liter, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) * m.rated_power_kw) AS rated_capacity_kwh, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS idle_reading_count, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL) = 0 THEN e.electricity_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS idle_electricity_kwh, MAX(e.peak_demand_kw) AS max_peak_demand_kw, AVG(e.peak_demand_kw) AS avg_peak_demand_kw FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id WHERE m.machine_id IN (?) GROUP BY m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.rated_power_kw) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

dataQualityNotes: Production, quality, and order-linked downtime share transactional keys; daily energy is aligned by machine/date rather than directly linked to an order.
Inventory balances are inferred from cumulative movements; finished goods have no sales-shipment demand basis.
Supplier and inventory domains remain plant-wide when machineIds or lineIds filters are used because those domains have no machine/line key.
Cross-domain risk flags are threshold-based screening signals, not causal conclusions.

externalSources.title: 振动信号:工业设备自带的健康报警器

externalSources.title: 为什么振动检测是预测性维护(PdM)核心
externalSources.excerptPreview: 1. 总体值监测(ISO 10816 / 20816 标准) 测量振动速度有效值(mm/s),对照国际标准判断设备处于 A/B/C/D 哪个等级。简单、便宜,适合做"有没有问题"的粗筛,但说不出具体是什么故障。 2. 频谱分析(FFT) 最主流的一层。看频谱图上的峰值频率,结合设备转速、轴承型号、齿轮齿数等参数,计算各部件的特征频率,定位故障类型与部位。绝大多数振动分析服务都落在这一层。 3. 包络解调 / 冲击脉冲(轴承与齿轮专项) 早期轴承点蚀、齿轮微裂纹产生的冲击能量很弱,会被淹没在背景噪声里。包络解调技术通过高频共振带提取+解调,能把微弱的周期性冲击"放大"出来,比常规频谱提前数周到数

externalSources.title: 振动测量仪
externalSources.excerptPreview: 振动测量仪是一款基于微处理器设计的机器状态监测仪器,主要功能包括振动测量、轴承状态分析及红外线温度测量,可应用于桥梁建筑、工业设备、汽车制造及结构健康监测等领域。 该仪器配备压电式加速度传感器,支持振动速度、加速度、位移值的测量,部分型号符合国际标准ISO 2954。整机采用锂离子电池供电,续航时间达48小时,重量220克,尺寸为115×70-80×25mm,配置中文菜单操作界面和自动状态报警系统,部分型号具备USB、RS-232或蓝牙数据输出功能。通过三轴加速度计可采集三维振动信号,配合频谱分析仪实现设备故障诊断与共振频率分析,特别适合现场设备运维人员快速识别异常状态。 产品类型:电子产品

externalSources.title: OPC-2300在线颗粒计数器 液压系统监测
externalSources.excerptPreview: 在线监测的必要性 液压系统的污染度等级通常按 ISO 4406、GB/T 14039 进行编码,油液颗粒计数方法参考 ISO 11500 规定的消光原理。离线检测的取样瓶洁净度、转运时间和实验室排队都会让数据滞后于真实工况;一旦油品在两次取样之间被新的磨屑或外界侵入污染,阀件已经发生磨粒磨损。 OPC-2300 在线颗粒计数器直接串接或旁路安装在液压管路上,按设定周期连续采集油样,输出 ISO 4406、NAS 1638 污染度代码。当某一粒径区间颗粒数越过阈值时,设备本地声光提示并向上位机推送报警信号,提示运维人员切换过滤系统、检查密封件或取样化验,而不是等到系统压降异常、动作迟缓再停机排查

externalSources.title: Bebur巴倍尔液体颗粒计数器在液冷不锈钢波纹管清洁度检测中的应用
externalSources.excerptPreview: 根据T/CAEE 098-2026《数据中心液冷系统用管路及组件通用技术要求》,不锈钢波纹管出厂产品清洁度等级应不低于ISO 4406 16/14/11级(或双方协议等级)。 ISO 4406是国际标准化组织制定的液压传动流体固体颗粒污染等级标准,它通过一套标准化的代码,将复杂的颗粒计数数据转化为简洁的等级,以便于沟通和比较。ISO 4406代码由三个用斜杠分隔的数字组成(例如16/14/11),每个数字代表每毫升液体中等于或大于特定尺寸的颗粒数量。 第一个数字:代表≥4μm(c)的颗粒数量等级。 第二个数字:代表≥6μm(c)的颗粒数量等级。 第三个数字:代表≥14μm(c)的颗粒数量等级。

externalSources.title: 油液颗粒计数器
externalSources.excerptPreview: 油液颗粒计数器是测试油液中颗粒粒径及其分布的专用仪器。它主要采用光阻法(遮光法)原理,可广泛应用于液压油、润滑油、变压器油等油液的污染度检测,在电力、航空航天、石油化工、机械制造等领域均有应用。 该仪器能快速测定油液颗粒污染度,其检测粒径范围通常覆盖1μm至数百微米。现代便携式设备集成了颗粒计数、水分及温度检测等多功能,具有检测速度快、精度高、便于现场操作等特点,其检测结果通常依据ISO 4406、NAS 1638等国际或行业标准进行评定。

externalSources.title: 在线式油液颗粒计数器:工业设备的 “健康听诊器”
externalSources.excerptPreview: 1.液压系统预防性维护 在某港口起重机液压站中,在线式颗粒计数器实时监测 20MPa 高压油路,当铁磁性颗粒浓度超过 ISO 4406 的 18/16/13 级时自动触发报警,使液压阀卡滞故障率从年均 12 次降至 2 次,维护成本降低 60%。设备内置的磨损趋势分析模型,可通过颗粒增长速率预判元件磨损阶段,将计划检修周期从 6 个月延长至 9 个月。

externalSources.title: 颗粒计数系统

externalSources.excerptPreview: 缩孔(缩松) 特征:缩孔是铸件表面或内部存在的一种表面粗糙的孔,轻微缩孔是许多分散的小缩孔,即缩松,缩孔或缩松处晶粒粗大。常发生在铸件内浇道附近、冒口根部、厚大部位,壁的厚薄转接处及具有大平面的厚薄处。 形成原因: 1、模具工作温度控制未达到定向凝固要求。 2、涂料选择不当,不同部位涂料层厚度控制不好。 3、铸件在模具中的位置设计不当。 4、浇冒口设计未能达到起充分补缩的作用。

Inventory balances are inferred from cumulative movements; finished goods have no sales-shipment demand basis.
Supplier and inventory domains remain plant-wide when machineIds or lineIds filters are used because those domains have no machine/line key.
Cross-domain risk flags are threshold-based screening signals, not causal conclusions.

GROUP BY o.machine_id, period ), quality AS ( SELECT o.machine_id, substr(q.inspection_time,1,7) AS period, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result='?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, SUM(q.sample_size) AS sample_size, SUM(q.defect_count) AS defect_count FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id=q.order_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id=o.machine_id WHERE m.machine_id IN (?,?) GROUP BY o.machine_id, period ), downtime AS ( SELECT d.machine_id, substr(d.start_time,1,7) AS period, SUM(CASE WHEN d.planned_flag=0 THEN d.duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS unplanned_downtime_min, SUM(CASE WHEN d.category='?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_count FROM downtime_events d JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id=d.machine_id WHERE m.machine_id IN (?,?) GROUP BY d.machine_id, period ), energy AS ( SELECT e.machine_id, substr(e.reading_date,1,7) AS period, SUM(e.electricity_kwh) AS electricity_kwh, SUM(CAST(e.runtime_hours AS REAL)) AS runtime_hours FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id=e.machine_id WHERE m.machine_id IN (?,?) GROUP BY e.machine_id, period ), keys AS ( SELECT machine_id,period FROM production UNION SELECT machine_id,period FROM quality UNION SELECT machine_id,period FROM downtime UNION SELECT machine_id,period FROM energy ) SELECT k.machine_id,k.period,p.planned_qty,p.actual_qty,p.good_qty,p.scrap_qty, ROUND(p.actual_qty*1.0/NULLIF(p.planned_qty,0),4) AS plan_completion_rate, RO

kwh_per_good_unit aligns energy and production by the selected machine/date scope, not by a direct meter-to-order link.
Electric load factor uses rated power multiplied by recorded runtime hours as the denominator.
Energy and production are independently pre-aggregated by machine and period before alignment; raw fact tables are never directly joined.
Timestamp scopes use an inclusive start and exclusive next-day boundary, preventing end-of-day production records from being dropped.
highEnergyLowOutput means above-factory kWh per good unit and below-average good quantity; it is a screening rule, not a causal finding.

externalSources.excerptPreview: 一、先说清楚:ISO50001到底是什么,为什么山西企业扎堆办 ISO50001 是国际标准化组织发布的能源管理体系标准,现行有效版本为 ISO 50001:2018,我国等同采用的国标是GB/T 23331-2020。它管的不是"产品好不好",而是"企业耗掉的电、热、气、油、水、蒸汽等能源,能不能被系统地管住,并且一年比一年更省"。 用一句大白话概括差别: ISO 9001管的是质量——产品合格率、客户投诉; ISO 14001管的是环境——污染物排放、废弃物合规; ISO 45001管的是安全——员工工伤与职业健康; ISO 50001管的是能源——每吨钢、每吨水泥、每平方米墙面的能耗账。

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT MIN(date_from) AS date_from, MAX(date_to) AS date_to FROM (SELECT MIN(substr(o.actual_start,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(o.actual_start,1,10)) AS date_to FROM production_orders o JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE o.actual_start IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(q.inspection_time,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(q.inspection_time,1,10)) AS date_to FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE q.inspection_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(d.start_time,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(d.start_time,1,10)) AS date_to FROM downtime_events d JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = d.machine_id WHERE d.start_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT MIN(substr(e.reading_date,1,10)) AS date_from, MAX(substr(e.reading_date,1,10)) AS date_to FROM energy_readings e JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = e.machine_id WHERE e.reading_date IS NOT NULL)) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.planned_qty) AS planned_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) - SUM(o.planned_qty) AS plan_variance_qty, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_qty), 0), 4) AS plan_completion_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.good_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS yield_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.scrap_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS scrap_rate, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_cycle_time_min, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_standard_cycle_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min), 0), 4) AS cycle_time_index, ROUND(AVG((julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0), 2) AS avg_start_delay_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY actual_qty DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS pass_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS fail_rate, SUM(q.sample_size) AS sample_size, SUM(q.defect_count) AS defect_count, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 4) AS sample_defect_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 2) AS defects_per_1000_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defect_free_inspection_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS defect_free_inspection_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_spec_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS out_of_spec_rate FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY inspection_count DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT * FROM (SELECT m.machine_id, m.line_id, m.machine_type, m.manufacturer, m.install_date, m.rated_power_kw, m.status FROM machines m ORDER BY m.machine_id) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS group_key, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) AS ideal_runtime_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY group_key) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

OFFSET ?

externalSources.excerptPreview: 在各类工业环境中,机器一直在跟我们“说话”。它们不是用语言与我们沟通交流,而是通过运动、热量、噪声、压力,尤其是振动等物理现象,清晰地传递自身等健康信息。长期以来,在大多数情况下,只有行业专家才能理解这种语言;如今,随着传感器技术和边缘人工智能的进步,解读这一语言的门槛正在降低,有更多的技工能够听懂机器在说什么,整个行业正迎来一场深刻变革。 其核心原理非常简单却具说服力:机器振动如果测量得足够精确,就能在故障发生前,提前揭示设备内部正在发生的问题。轴承开始磨损、变速箱对中不良、零部件松动等故障部件往往最先通过振动的变化预示健康异常情况。这些异常变化起初可能微乎其微,若置之不理,时间久了会愈发明

externalSources.title: 机械磨损震动监测
externalSources.excerptPreview: 本方案面向工业设备运行过程中的机械磨损及振动异常监测,采用高灵敏度加速度传感器、震动分析模块与边缘计算设备,结合4G/以太网远程通信方式,对关键设备运行状态进行连续监控,及时识别潜在故障征兆,实现早预警、远诊断与预维护,广泛应用于电机、风机、轴承、齿轮箱等旋转设备。 监测目标 实时监测设备运行中产生的机械震动强度和频率 分析振动信号中出现的异常趋势以识别磨损、松动或失衡问题 记录长期磨损特征变化趋势,为设备检修提供数据依据 实现故障预警,提升设备运行稳定性与寿命 需求分析 要求传感器具备高频响应与高精度,适应工业复杂振动特征 系统应支持边缘预处理、频谱分析与远程数据查看 通信方式应兼容4G/有

externalSources.title: 为什么振动检测是预测性维护(PdM)核心
externalSources.excerptPreview: 1. 总体值监测(ISO 10816 / 20816 标准) 测量振动速度有效值(mm/s),对照国际标准判断设备处于 A/B/C/D 哪个等级。简单、便宜,适合做"有没有问题"的粗筛,但说不出具体是什么故障。 2. 频谱分析(FFT) 最主流的一层。看频谱图上的峰值频率,结合设备转速、轴承型号、齿轮齿数等参数,计算各部件的特征频率,定位故障类型与部位。绝大多数振动分析服务都落在这一层。 3. 包络解调 / 冲击脉冲(轴承与齿轮专项) 早期轴承点蚀、齿轮微裂纹产生的冲击能量很弱,会被淹没在背景噪声里。包络解调技术通过高频共振带提取+解调,能把微弱的周期性冲击"放大"出来,比常规频谱提前数周到数

externalSources.title: 振动测量仪
externalSources.excerptPreview: 振动测量仪是一款基于微处理器设计的机器状态监测仪器,主要功能包括振动测量、轴承状态分析及红外线温度测量,可应用于桥梁建筑、工业设备、汽车制造及结构健康监测等领域。 该仪器配备压电式加速度传感器,支持振动速度、加速度、位移值的测量,部分型号符合国际标准ISO 2954。整机采用锂离子电池供电,续航时间达48小时,重量220克,尺寸为115×70-80×25mm,配置中文菜单操作界面和自动状态报警系统,部分型号具备USB、RS-232或蓝牙数据输出功能。通过三轴加速度计可采集三维振动信号,配合频谱分析仪实现设备故障诊断与共振频率分析,特别适合现场设备运维人员快速识别异常状态。 产品类型:电子产品

externalSources.title: 换完轴承振动还是超标?一倍频谱怎么区分轴承缺陷与动平衡不良
externalSources.excerptPreview: 【导语】动平衡检测哪家好,第一个该核验的不是报价,而是它能不能把"轴承缺陷"和"动平衡不良"分 开。这两类问题都会让转速一倍频(1X)升高,只看"一倍频大"永远分不出来。本篇用两台 750 RPM 增压风机的实测数据,讲清三个可落地的判别方法,以及为什么"先校正、后换轴承"往往能省掉一半工作量。 一台风机振动超标,拆开一看轴承有点响,于是换轴承。装回去一开机——振动没降多少。 钱花了、停机了、活干了,问题还在。这个场景在工业现场非常常见。 根本原因在于:轴承缺陷和叶轮动平衡不良,都会让"转速一倍频"变高。 只看"一倍频大"这一个现象,永远分不出来是哪一个。 下面用一个现场案例,把判别方法讲透。

SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.machine_id AS machine_id, m.machine_type AS machine_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.planned_qty) AS planned_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) - SUM(o.planned_qty) AS plan_variance_qty, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_qty), 0), 4) AS plan_completion_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.good_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS yield_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.scrap_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS scrap_rate, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_cycle_time_min, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_standard_cycle_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min), 0), 4) AS cycle_time_index, ROUND(AVG((julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0), 2) AS avg_start_delay_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY actual_qty DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS pass_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS fail_rate, SUM(q.sample_size) AS sample_size, SUM(q.defect_count) AS defect_count, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 4) AS sample_defect_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 2) AS defects_per_1000_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defect_free_inspection_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS defect_free_inspection_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_spec_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS out_of_spec_rate FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id GROUP BY o.machine_id, m.machine_type ORDER BY inspection_count DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.product_id) AS product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.machine_id) AS machine_count, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.planned_qty) AS planned_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) AS actual_qty, SUM(o.good_qty) AS good_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(o.actual_qty) - SUM(o.planned_qty) AS plan_variance_qty, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.planned_qty), 0), 4) AS plan_completion_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.good_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS yield_rate, ROUND(SUM(o.scrap_qty) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 4) AS scrap_rate, SUM(o.runtime_min) AS runtime_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_cycle_time_min, ROUND(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty), 0), 3) AS weighted_standard_cycle_min, ROUND(SUM(o.runtime_min) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.actual_qty * p.standard_cycle_min), 0), 4) AS cycle_time_index, ROUND(AVG((julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0), 2) AS avg_start_delay_min FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.product_id) AS product_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.machine_id) AS machine_count, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS pass_rate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS fail_rate, SUM(q.sample_size) AS sample_size, SUM(q.defect_count) AS defect_count, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 4) AS sample_defect_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.defect_count) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.sample_size), 0), 2) AS defects_per_1000_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defect_free_inspection_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.defect_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS defect_free_inspection_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_spec_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS out_of_spec_rate FROM quality_inspections q JOIN production_orders o ON o.order_id = q.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN o.scrap_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.actual_qty, 0) > ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0 > ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN o.cycle_time_min > p.standard_cycle_min * (1.0 + ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity_score, TRIM( CASE WHEN o.actual_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.planned_qty, 0) < ? THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN o.scrap_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.actual_qty, 0) > ? THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN (julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0 > ? THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN o.cycle_time_min > p.standard_cycle_min * (1.0 + ?) THEN '?' ELSE '?' END, '?' ) AS exception_reasons FROM production_orders o JOIN products p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN machines m ON m.machine_id = o.machine_id WHERE (o.actual_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.planned_qty, 0) < ? OR o.scrap_qty * 1.0 / NULLIF(o.actual_qty, 0) > ? OR (julianday(o.actual_start) - julianday(o.planned_start)) * 1440.0 > ? OR o.cycle_time_min > p.standard_cycle_min * (1.0 + ?)) ORDER BY severity_score DESC, scrap_rate DESC, start_delay_min DESC) AS _mcp_query LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity_score, TRIM(CASE WHEN q.result = '?' THEN '?' ELSE '?' END || CASE WHEN q.measured_value_mm < q.spec_lower_mm OR q.measured_value_mm > q.spec_upper_mm THEN '?' ELSE '?'
